new_lead.title: HHS Digital Stockpile & Manufacturing Response Network Challenge
verified_facts: Phase 1 submissions are due August 28, 2026 at 8 PM on the challenge host.
Total prize pool is up to $2.04 million across three phases.
Phase 1 requires an 8-page paper, a 3-minute pitch video, and a blueprint.
Up to eight Phase 1 finalists receive $5,000 each; up to three pitch-event winners receive $150,000 each.
Phase 2 provides up to $150,000 in milestone prizes per advancing team; Phase 3 has a total prize purse up to $1.1 million.

Individual prize eligibility requires age 18+ and U.S. citizenship or permanent residency; organizations must be U.S.-incorporated with a primary U.S. place of business; a team lead must be 18+ and a U.S. citizen/permanent resident.
Federal employees acting within scope are ineligible, and overlapping government funding for similar work can restrict eligibility.
The participant terms grant the U.S. Government broad/unlimited rights in qualifying solution data/work as described by the challenge agreement.
